Quick Rundown

UV = upvoats / DV = downvoats.

SCP: Submission contribution points

  • Earned when people voat on your submission posts (access via share a link/discuss).
  • First number by username.
  • Submission limits and captchas are actually lifted after acquiring 100 CCP (I think).

CCP: Comment contribution points

  • Earned when people voat on your comments.
  • Second number by username.
  • You need 20 CCP to be able to escape the 10 UV/day limit.
    We have a culture of UVing comments that contribute to the convo, even if we personally disagree.
  • You need 100 CCP to be able to DV.
    We also try to reserve DVs only for spam and malicious posting: DV button =/= disagree button.
  • Once you pass 20 CCP, you can give out half as many voats as you have within 24 hours.
    E.g., with 112 CCP, you can give out 56 UV/DV for the day.

Notes:

  • Third number by your username is # of UVs you've given out (go to your profile page for the breakdown).
  • SCP/CCP cannot be earned or lost in anonymous posts or private subs.
  • Posts can't be downvoated after seven days.
  • After three months, threads are archived and no voating is allowed -- only viewing.
  • To create your own subverse (see sidebar in v/all), you need 10 SCP, 10 CCP, and a 30 day old account.
  • Not sure, but I think you need 20 CCP to initiate PMs.

More Detailed Explanation:
